```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def points_attribute(points):
    return " ".join(f"{x},{y}" for x, y in points)


width = 1200
height = 590
operations = [
    {
        "x": 20,
        "label": "Selecció / extracció",
        "geometry": "A completa",
        "attributes": "A",
        "mode": "selection",
    },
    {
        "x": 420,
        "label": "Retall (clip)",
        "geometry": "A ∩ B",
        "attributes": "A",
        "mode": "clip",
    },
    {
        "x": 820,
        "label": "Intersecció",
        "geometry": "A ∩ B",
        "attributes": "A + B",
        "mode": "intersection",
    },
]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="selection-title selection-desc">',
    '  <title id="selection-title">Selecció, retall i intersecció de les mateixes geometries</title>',
    '  <desc id="selection-desc">Comparació en tres columnes d’una línia A que travessa un polígon B. La selecció o extracció conserva tota la línia A i els seus atributs; el retall conserva A intersecció B i els atributs d’A; la intersecció conserva la mateixa part comuna i combina els atributs d’A i B.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17252d; }",
    "      .layer { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }",
    "      .key { font-size: 24px; fill: #55656d; }",
    "      .value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17252d; }",
    "      .rule { stroke: #bdc8cd; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .mask { fill: #a9d3e4; fill-opacity: .55; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 2.5; }",
    "      .mask-context { fill: #dcebf1; fill-opacity: .35; stroke: #7896a4; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 7 6; }",
    "      .source { fill: none; stroke: #c75038; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }",
    "      .source-context { fill: none; stroke: #9aa8af; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }",
    "      .result { fill: none; stroke: #a93422; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#52616b"/>',
    '    </marker>',
]

for index, operation in enumerate(operations):
    x = operation["x"]
    output_mask = [
        (x + 105, 330),
        (x + 310, 346),
        (x + 280, 450),
        (x + 125, 462),
    ]
    svg.extend([
        f'    <clipPath id="result-clip-{index}">',
        f'      <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}"/>',
        '    </clipPath>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  </defs>',
    '  <line x1="400" y1="18" x2="400" y2="572" class="rule"/>',
    '  <line x1="800" y1="18" x2="800" y2="572" class="rule"/>',
])

for index, operation in enumerate(operations):
    x = operation["x"]
    input_mask = [
        (x + 105, 110),
        (x + 310, 126),
        (x + 280, 230),
        (x + 125, 242),
    ]
    output_mask = [
        (x + 105, 330),
        (x + 310, 346),
        (x + 280, 450),
        (x + 125, 462),
    ]
    input_line = f'M {x + 34},218 C {x + 122},205 {x + 215},126 {x + 342},148'
    output_line = f'M {x + 34},438 C {x + 122},425 {x + 215},346 {x + 342},368'
    svg.extend([
        f'  <text x="{x + 180}" y="43" text-anchor="middle" class="heading">{operation["label"]}</text>',
        f'  <line x1="{x + 20}" y1="62" x2="{x + 340}" y2="62" class="rule"/>',
        f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(input_mask)}" class="mask"/>',
        f'  <path d="{input_line}" class="source"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 48}" y="198" class="layer" fill="#9d3625">A</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 264}" y="174" class="layer" fill="#1f668a">B</text>',
        f'  <line x1="{x + 180}" y1="266" x2="{x + 180}" y2="305" stroke="#52616b" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    ])
    if operation["mode"] == "selection":
        svg.extend([
            f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}" class="mask-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="result"/>',
        ])
    else:
        svg.extend([
            f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}" class="mask-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="source-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="result" clip-path="url(#result-clip-{index})"/>',
        ])
    svg.extend([
        f'  <line x1="{x + 20}" y1="490" x2="{x + 340}" y2="490" class="rule"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 20}" y="526" class="key">Geometria</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 340}" y="526" text-anchor="end" class="value">{operation["geometry"]}</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 20}" y="562" class="key">Atributs</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 340}" y="562" text-anchor="end" class="value">{operation["attributes"]}</text>',
    ])

svg.append('</svg>')

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/selection-overlay.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
